items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: But the guy was white with a China man, Fugger Nick. Man, he got everybody a brand new instrument.

ctx.x: Well you should have did that little routine every Sunday then, make them think it's part of the act.

Yeah. I didn't wait for two Sundays ago. See I had a steady job, I worked at Golden Lily, see. We worked there six years, you know. Six, eight years, Golden Lily. And we'd have been there longer, but one Saturday night we all played to two o'clock. And went home and a cab driver come by my house and said, hey Punch, see, you're honing the Golden Lily? I said, yeah, why? Golden Lily on fire. Boy. Rambling around there, trying to get them, we couldn't get them. But the guy was white with a China man, Fugger Nick.…
Well that's what you really call getting fired, huh?
